{{< pagebreak >}}

Fire is the first magic. It's the magic of anger, of hunger, of the campfire that keeps the dark at bay. Every mage starts with fire, and most never stop.

But fire's just the beginning. Ice that freezes blood in the veins. Lightning that jumps from foe to foe like it's choosing favorites. Acid that doesn't just burn, it *unmakes.* Force magic that hits like a battering ram made of pure will. Illusions that make trained soldiers stab at shadows. The cold arithmetic of necromancy. The whisper that becomes a command. The body reshaped into something faster, harder, deadlier.

Arcane magic is the art of telling the universe to sit down and shut up, and making it listen. You don't ask. You don't pray. You *impose.*

This chapter contains every arcane spell in the game, thirty cards in all. Each card is a single spell: a Discipline, an action, a range, and an effect that scales across Weak, Standard, and Strong, then grows at Adept and Master. Key the numbers to the damage budget (@sec-damage-budget), and cast.

*See @sec-chapter-magic-system for how spellcasting works.*

{{< pagebreak >}}

## Arcane Cantrips

Cantrips are minor spells. The magic you learn before you learn *real* magic. They don't require Disciplines, they don't cost anything to learn, and you can cast them as often as you like, at-will, every round, all day. Every arcane caster knows all of these.

They won't win a fight by themselves. But they'll start one, end one, or change the terms of one. Never underestimate a caster who knows exactly what their cantrips can do.

### Arcane Mark (Cantrip)
**No prereq**
**Casting Time:** 1 action
**Range:** Touch
**Duration:** Permanent until dispelled
**Target:** One surface or object

**Description:** You inscribe your personal sigil, invisible to normal sight, onto any surface. The mark is unique to you. It can be made visible with a word, and it glows under magical detection.

| Outcome | Effect |
|---------|--------|
| Weak (1-8) | The mark is faint. Detection spells reveal it, but the image is blurry. |
| Standard (9-14) | Clean, permanent mark. Visible on command, unmistakably yours. |
| Strong (15-18+) | The mark is flawless. You may also sense when any creature touches it within 100 feet for the next 24 hours. |

*Your signature on the world. Some mages use it to claim territory. Some to leave messages. Some to remind an enemy who burned their house down.*

### Dancing Lights (Cantrip)
**No prereq**
**Casting Time:** 1 action
**Range:** 60 feet
**Duration:** Concentration, up to 1 minute
**Target:** Up to 4 points in range

**Description:** You create up to four torch-bright orbs of light that hover and move at your command. Each sheds light in a 10-foot radius. You can combine them into a single glowing humanoid shape.

| Outcome | Effect |
|---------|--------|
| Weak (1-8) | Two dim orbs. Light radius halved. They flicker. |
| Standard (9-14) | Four bright orbs or one glowing shape. Full control of movement. |
| Strong (15-18+) | The lights are dazzling. One creature of your choice within the light radius has Bane on its next attack. |

*Better than a torch. Worse than a fireball. But they don't go out in the rain, and they'll follow you down any hole you're stupid enough to climb into.*

### Frost Touch (Cantrip)
**No prereq**
**Casting Time:** 1 action
**Range:** Touch
**Duration:** Instantaneous
**Target:** One creature or object

**Description:** Your hand erupts in freezing cold. A creature you touch takes 3 cold damage. A liquid you touch freezes solid in a 1-foot cube for 1 minute. A small object becomes brittle.

| Outcome | Effect |
|---------|--------|
| Weak (1-8) | 1 cold damage. Liquid chills but doesn't freeze. |
| Standard (9-14) | 3 cold damage. Liquid freezes solid. |
| Strong (15-18+) | 5 cold damage. Target's next physical action has Bane as cold numbs their limbs. |

*The first spell every ice mage learns. Touch a lock. Touch a rope. Touch a throat. Cold solves problems heat can't.*

### Ghost Sound (Cantrip)
**No prereq**
**Casting Time:** 1 action
**Range:** 30 feet
**Duration:** Concentration, up to 1 minute
**Target:** One point in range

**Description:** You create a sound that originates from a point you choose, footsteps, a whispered voice, a door slamming, a growl. The sound can be as quiet as a breath or as loud as a scream.

| Outcome | Effect |
|---------|--------|
| Weak (1-8) | One brief, obvious sound. Anyone listening gets a Reason check to recognize it as magical. |
| Standard (9-14) | Sustained or repeating sounds. Believable enough to distract or mislead. |
| Strong (15-18+) | Complex audio, a full sentence in a recognizable voice, or a soundscape (approaching guards, a wolf pack circling). |

*The oldest trick in the book. Still works. Guards have been chasing phantom footsteps since the first wizard figured out this spell, and guards will be chasing them long after you're dust.*

### Mage Hand (Cantrip)
**No prereq**
**Casting Time:** 1 action
**Range:** 30 feet
**Duration:** Concentration, up to 1 minute
**Target:** One unattended object up to 10 pounds

**Description:** A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose. It can manipulate objects, open doors, pull levers, or deliver items. The hand can't attack or activate magic items.

| Outcome | Effect |
|---------|--------|
| Weak (1-8) | The hand is clumsy. Fine manipulation fails. Objects may be dropped. |
| Standard (9-14) | Precise control. The hand can turn keys, pour liquids, or lift up to 10 pounds. |
| Strong (15-18+) | The hand is preternaturally deft. It can pick pockets, disarm simple traps, or deliver a potion to an ally's lips mid-combat. |

*You will use this spell more than any other. You will open things you shouldn't open. You will touch things you shouldn't touch. You will learn. Or you won't.*

### Prestidigitation (Cantrip)
**No prereq**
**Casting Time:** 1 action
**Range:** 10 feet
**Duration:** Up to 1 hour
**Target:** See below

**Description:** The workhorse of minor magic. You may produce one of the following effects at a time: light or snuff a candle, clean or soil an object, chill or warm a drink, create a harmless sensory effect (a shower of sparks, a faint breeze, a whisper of perfume), or color a small object for 1 hour. You can have up to three non-instantaneous effects active at once.

| Outcome | Effect |
|---------|--------|
| Weak (1-8) | One effect. It's crude, the sparks are dull, the cleaning is smeary. |
| Standard (9-14) | Up to three simultaneous effects. Each works exactly as intended. |
| Strong (15-18+) | Your effects are especially vivid or lasting. The perfume lingers for hours. The sparks are bright enough to briefly distract. The cleaning removes stains that have been there for years. |

*It's what separates wizards from lantern-bearers. Anyone can throw fire. Making a goblin warlord's dinner taste like ashes from thirty feet away? That's art.*

### Spark (Cantrip)
**No prereq**
**Casting Time:** 1 action
**Range:** 30 feet
**Duration:** Instantaneous
**Target:** One flammable object

**Description:** You snap your fingers and produce a pinpoint of intense heat. It ignites one flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, paper, dry wood, oil, cloth, gunpowder.

| Outcome | Effect |
|---------|--------|
| Weak (1-8) | The object smolders. It may catch fire after 1 round if left alone. |
| Standard (9-14) | Immediate ignition. The object catches fire and burns normally. |
| Strong (15-18+) | The flame leaps. Adjacent flammable objects also catch fire. |

*Every Pyromancer's first spell. Also their last, if they're not careful about where they point it. Fire doesn't care about your intentions. Fire cares about what's flammable.*

### Static Shock (Cantrip)
**No prereq**
**Casting Time:** 1 action
**Range:** 30 feet
**Duration:** Instantaneous
**Target:** One creature

**Description:** A spark of electricity arcs from your fingertip to the target. Deals 3 lightning damage. Metal-armored targets take +1 damage.

| Outcome | Effect |
|---------|--------|
| Weak (1-8) | 1 lightning damage. The target feels a tingle. |
| Standard (9-14) | 3 lightning damage. +1 vs. metal armor. |
| Strong (15-18+) | 5 lightning damage. The spark chains to one additional target within 10 feet for half damage. |

*The crackle before the storm. Doesn't look like much. Hurts more than it looks. Aim for the one in plate.*

### Acid Splash (Cantrip)
**No prereq**
**Casting Time:** 1 action
**Range:** 30 feet
**Duration:** Instantaneous
**Target:** One creature or object

**Description:** You hurl a glob of corrosive acid. Deals 3 acid damage. Against objects, the acid ignores 1 point of hardness.

| Outcome | Effect |
|---------|--------|
| Weak (1-8) | 1 acid damage. The acid sizzles weakly. |
| Standard (9-14) | 3 acid damage. Ignores 1 hardness against objects. |
| Strong (15-18+) | 5 acid damage. The acid clings, target takes 5 additional acid damage at the start of its next turn. |

*Not flashy. Not dramatic. But acid doesn't care how thick your armor is. It finds the gaps. It always finds the gaps.*

### Whisper (Cantrip)
**No prereq**
**Casting Time:** 1 action
**Range:** 120 feet
**Duration:** Instantaneous
**Target:** One creature you can see

**Description:** You send a short message, up to 25 words, directly into the mind of a creature you can see. The target recognizes you as the sender if it knows you. The target cannot reply.

| Outcome | Effect |
|---------|--------|
| Weak (1-8) | The message is garbled. Key words may be lost. |
| Standard (9-14) | Clear message. 25 words, perfectly delivered. |
| Strong (15-18+) | The message carries emotional weight, urgency, calm, menace. The target understands not just the words but the intent behind them. |

*No hand signals. No shouting across a crowded room. Just your voice in their skull. Use it to coordinate. Use it to intimidate. Use it to remind the DA's villain that you know exactly where they sleep.*

## Arcane Spells

### Ember Lance

**Ember Lance — Arcane Spell**
1 Fire · Action · 30 ft · Piercing, Recurring

**Weak:** 2 fire damage.

**Standard:** 4 fire damage; the lance passes through to one target behind for 2 fire damage.

**Strong:** 6 fire damage; 4 fire damage to one target behind.

**Adept:** 6/9/12 fire damage, Piercing 2.

**Master:** 9/15/21 fire damage, Piercing 3; leaves a burning patch (Recurring 2, 3 rounds).

### Brimstone Burst

**Brimstone Burst — Arcane Spell**
2 Fire · Action · 20-ft radius · Recurring

**Weak:** 2 fire damage to all in the radius.

**Standard:** 4 fire damage to all; targets at the center take +2.

**Strong:** 6 fire damage to all; targets at the center take +3.

**Adept:** 6/9/12 fire damage to all, center +3.

**Master:** 9/15/21 fire damage to all; the ground burns (Recurring 4, 2 rounds).

### Wall of Cinders

**Wall of Cinders — Arcane Spell**
2 Fire · Action · 30-ft wall

**Weak:** 2 fire damage to creatures passing through.

**Standard:** 4 fire damage to passers.

**Strong:** 6 fire damage to passers; ignites flammables.

**Adept:** 6/9/12 fire damage to passers; the wall lasts 2 rounds.

**Master:** 9/15/21 fire damage to passers; the wall lasts 3 rounds.

### Burning Volley

**Burning Volley — Arcane Spell**
1 Fire · Action · 60 ft

**Weak:** 2 fire damage, split across three lances.

**Standard:** 4 fire damage, split across three lances.

**Strong:** 6 fire damage, split across three lances.

**Adept:** 6/9/12 fire damage; the lances may split targets.

**Master:** 9/15/21 fire damage, split across five lances.

### Frostbite Shard

**Frostbite Shard — Arcane Spell**
1 Cold · Action · 30 ft · Slowed, Frozen

**Weak:** 2 cold damage.

**Standard:** 4 cold damage; the target's Movement is halved for 1 turn.

**Strong:** 6 cold damage; the target is Slowed.

**Adept:** 6/9/12 cold damage.

**Master:** 9/15/21 cold damage; Frozen on Strong.

### Rime Storm

**Rime Storm — Arcane Spell**
2 Cold · Action · 15-ft radius · Slowed, Frozen

**Weak:** 2 cold damage.

**Standard:** 4 cold damage; targets are Slowed.

**Strong:** 6 cold damage; targets are Slowed for 2 rounds.

**Adept:** 6/9/12 cold damage.

**Master:** 9/15/21 cold damage; Frozen on Strong.

### Glacial Prison

**Glacial Prison — Arcane Spell**
2 Cold · Action · 30 ft · Restrained, Frozen

**Weak:** 2 cold damage.

**Standard:** 4 cold damage; the target is Restrained (break: Standard Athletics, once per turn).

**Strong:** 6 cold damage; the target is Restrained for 2 rounds.

**Adept:** 6/9/12 cold damage.

**Master:** 9/15/21 cold damage; Frozen instead of Restrained.

### Storm Javelin

**Storm Javelin — Arcane Spell**
1 Lightning · Action · 60 ft · Bane

**Weak:** 2 lightning damage.

**Standard:** 4 lightning damage; the target has Bane on its next attack.

**Strong:** 6 lightning damage; the target has Bane on its next 2 attacks.

**Adept:** 6/9/12 lightning damage.

**Master:** 9/15/21 lightning damage; arcs to one adjacent target for half.

### Forked Sky

**Forked Sky — Arcane Spell**
2 Lightning · Action · 30 ft

**Weak:** 2 lightning damage, split across three arcs.

**Standard:** 4 lightning damage, split across three arcs.

**Strong:** 6 lightning damage, split across three arcs.

**Adept:** 6/9/12 lightning damage, split across four arcs.

**Master:** 9/15/21 lightning damage, split across five arcs.

### Static Field

**Static Field — Arcane Spell**
2 Lightning · Action · 10-ft radius

**Weak:** 2 lightning damage to all adjacent targets.

**Standard:** 4 lightning damage to all adjacent.

**Strong:** 6 lightning damage to all adjacent; targets lose their Maneuver.

**Adept:** 6/9/12 lightning damage to all adjacent.

**Master:** 9/15/21 lightning damage; 15-ft radius.

### Corrosive Spit

**Corrosive Spit — Arcane Spell**
1 Acid · Action · 30 ft · DR

**Weak:** 2 acid damage.

**Standard:** 4 acid damage; the target's DR is reduced by 1 for 1 turn.

**Strong:** 6 acid damage; the target's DR is reduced by 2.

**Adept:** 6/9/12 acid damage, DR reduced by 2.

**Master:** 9/15/21 acid damage, DR reduced by 3.

### Caustic Mist

**Caustic Mist — Arcane Spell**
2 Acid · Action · 15-ft radius · Bane on sight

**Weak:** 2 acid damage.

**Standard:** 4 acid damage; targets have Bane on sight.

**Strong:** 6 acid damage; targets have Bane on sight for 2 rounds.

**Adept:** 6/9/12 acid damage.

**Master:** 9/15/21 acid damage; the mist lasts 2 rounds.

### Venom Lance

**Venom Lance — Arcane Spell**
1 Poison · Action · 30 ft · Bane

**Weak:** 2 poison damage.

**Standard:** 4 poison damage; Fortitude check or Bane.

**Strong:** 6 poison damage; Fortitude check or lose Maneuver.

**Adept:** 6/9/12 poison damage.

**Master:** 9/15/21 poison damage.

### Tremor

**Tremor — Arcane Spell**
2 Earth · Action · 10-ft radius · Prone

**Weak:** 2 bludgeoning damage.

**Standard:** 4 bludgeoning damage; targets are Prone.

**Strong:** 6 bludgeoning damage; targets are Prone and lose their Maneuver.

**Adept:** 6/9/12 bludgeoning damage.

**Master:** 9/15/21 bludgeoning damage; 15-ft radius.

### Gust

**Gust — Arcane Spell**
1 Wind · Action · 30 ft · Prone

**Weak:** No damage; push the target 5 ft.

**Standard:** Push the target 10 ft.

**Strong:** Push the target 15 ft; the target is Prone.

**Adept:** Push the target 20 ft.

**Master:** Push up to three targets 30 ft.

### Wind Wall

**Wind Wall — Arcane Spell**
2 Wind · Action · 30-ft wall · Bane

**Weak:** Missile attacks through the wall have Bane.

**Standard:** Missile attacks through the wall have Bane.

**Strong:** Missile attacks are blocked and pushed 5 ft.

**Adept:** The wall lasts 2 rounds; 6/9/12 bludgeoning damage to passers.

**Master:** The wall lasts 3 rounds; 9/15/21 bludgeoning damage to passers.

### Force Dart

**Force Dart — Arcane Spell**
1 Energy · Action · 60 ft

**Weak:** 2 force damage; never misses (the tier is still rolled).

**Standard:** 4 force damage.

**Strong:** 6 force damage.

**Adept:** 6/9/12 force damage, two darts.

**Master:** 9/15/21 force damage, three darts.

### Force Wave

**Force Wave — Arcane Spell**
2 Energy · Action · 15-ft cone · Prone

**Weak:** 2 force damage; push targets 5 ft.

**Standard:** 4 force damage; push targets 10 ft.

**Strong:** 6 force damage; push targets 15 ft; targets are Prone.

**Adept:** 6/9/12 force damage.

**Master:** 9/15/21 force damage.

### Ward of Iron

**Ward of Iron — Arcane Spell**
1 Energy · Reaction · self · DR

**Weak:** +2 DR against one attack.

**Standard:** +4 DR against one attack.

**Strong:** +6 DR against one attack; the attacker takes 2 damage.

**Adept:** 6/9/12 DR against one attack.

**Master:** 9/15/21 DR against one attack; reflects 3 damage.

### Unseen Hand

**Unseen Hand — Arcane Spell**
1 Energy · Action · 30 ft · Restrained

**Weak:** Lift 10 lb for 1 turn.

**Standard:** Lift 20 lb for 1 turn.

**Strong:** Lift 50 lb for 2 turns.

**Adept:** Lift 100 lb.

**Master:** Lift 200 lb; can hold a creature still (Restrained).

### Silver Tongue

**Silver Tongue — Arcane Spell**
1 Mind · Action · 30 ft · Bane, Boon

**Weak:** The target has Bane against your social checks for 1 scene.

**Standard:** The target has Bane against your social checks for 2 turns.

**Strong:** The target has Bane against your social checks and is friendly for 1 scene.

**Master:** The target is friendly and you gain Boon on social checks against them.

### Daze

**Daze — Arcane Spell**
1 Mind · Action · 30 ft

**Weak:** The target loses its Maneuver.

**Standard:** The target loses its Action.

**Strong:** The target loses its Action and Maneuver.

**Adept:** Two targets.

**Master:** Three targets.

### Phantasmal Image

**Phantasmal Image — Arcane Spell**
2 Mind · Action · 30 ft · Bane

**Weak:** The illusion lasts 1 turn.

**Standard:** The illusion lasts 2 turns.

**Strong:** The illusion lasts 3 turns; those who fail a Reason check have Bane.

### Fade

**Fade — Arcane Spell**
1 Mind · Action · self · Boon

**Weak:** Boon on Stealth for 1 turn.

**Standard:** Boon on Stealth for 2 turns.

**Strong:** Boon on Stealth for 3 turns; you cannot be targeted by sight.

**Master:** Allies within 5 ft also gain the effect.

### Mind Crown

**Mind Crown — Arcane Spell**
2 Mind · Action · 30 ft, 1 scene

**Weak:** The target follows one simple command (Reason resists).

**Standard:** The target follows two simple commands.

**Strong:** The target follows your commands for the full scene.

### Eldritch Sight

**Eldritch Sight — Arcane Spell**
1 Energy · Action · self

**Weak:** Reveal 1 clue about magic.

**Standard:** Reveal 2 clues about magic.

**Strong:** Reveal 3 clues about magic; the sight lasts 1 scene.

**Master:** Identify any magical effect.

### Flicker Step

**Flicker Step — Arcane Spell**
1 Energy · Maneuver · self · Boon, Bane

**Weak:** Teleport 5 ft.

**Standard:** Teleport 15 ft.

**Strong:** Teleport 30 ft; Boon on your next attack.

**Adept:** Teleport 45 ft.

**Master:** Teleport 60 ft; Bane on attacks against you for 1 turn.

### Soul Drain

**Soul Drain — Arcane Spell**
1 Energy · Action · 30 ft

**Weak:** 2 necrotic damage; heal half the damage.

**Standard:** 4 necrotic damage; heal half the damage.

**Strong:** 6 necrotic damage; heal 3.

**Adept:** 6/9/12 necrotic damage; heal half the damage.

**Master:** 9/15/21 necrotic damage; heal half the damage; slay at 0 HP.

### March of Bones

**March of Bones — Arcane Spell**
2 Energy · Action · 30 ft · Boon

**Weak:** Raise 1 skeleton for 1 scene.

**Standard:** Raise 2 skeletons for 1 scene.

**Strong:** Raise 3 skeletons for 1 hour.

**Adept:** Raise 4 skeletons for 1 hour.

**Master:** Raise 6 skeletons; their attacks have Boon.

### Touch of the Grave

**Touch of the Grave — Arcane Spell**
2 Energy · Action · touch · Unconscious

**Weak:** 2 necrotic damage.

**Standard:** 4 necrotic damage; Fortitude check or Unconscious.

**Strong:** 6 necrotic damage; Fortitude check or die at 0 HP.

**Adept:** 6/9/12 necrotic damage.

**Master:** 9/15/21 necrotic damage.
